proyectosDescripcion: Selected personal projects that reinforce my platform, automation, and infrastructure profile:
descripcion:
Platform Engineer with 9+ years of experience, starting in software development (Java/Spring backends, Python services, and full-stack applications) and growing into cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and platform engineering. Specialized in CI/CD, Kubernetes, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), with experience designing and operating high-criticality production environments.

Experience leading infrastructure and CI/CD migrations, optimizing pipelines, and building tools that improve the reliability and efficiency of deployments.

items: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, ECS, EKS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, Route 53, SNS, CloudWatch, Glue, IAM)

logros: Participated in the design and maintenance of the delivery platform in a high-throughput fintech environment, with thousands of changes deployed to production every day, focusing on reusable GitHub Actions, GitOps (ArgoCD/Kubernetes), and deployment process reliability.

Optimized shared pipelines for Java and Go applications, improving their performance and integrating Sonar, isolated testing environments with Signadot, and unit tests for the GitHub Actions themselves.
Applied two Istio routing migrations end-to-end across approximately 300 repositories, implementing a hierarchical VirtualServices model with delegation, with no service interruptions.
Redesigned the Canary Deployments promotion metric to evaluate canary signals instead of global production error rates, avoiding blockers when baseline services were already degraded.
Managed Datadog alerts for pipelines and Kubernetes infrastructure components using versioned configurations in Git and Terraform.
Documented technical standards and procedures to facilitate troubleshooting and improve the developer experience.
Worked as a cloud infrastructure consultant for clients in the financial and consumer technology sectors, taking ownership of Infrastructure as Code and delivery processes on AWS and Azure.

Designed and implemented infrastructure using Terraform and Terragrunt, including legacy module migrations, state import and centralization into a monorepo, and targeted solutions for platform problems.
Executed workload migrations and modernizations to AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, and RDS, plus DNS migrations to Route 53 and Kubernetes cluster upgrades on AWS and Azure.
Improved observability and operational response through Datadog monitors and a reusable CloudWatch → SNS → Lambda alerting pattern integrated with Microsoft Teams.
Designed and implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps for serverless applications, static sites deployed on S3 and CloudFront, infrastructure as code, and AWS Glue.
Developed internal tooling to automate infrastructure migrations and imports and streamline operations via the AWS CLI.
Joined as a Scala developer and evolved into a DevOps role, taking ownership of pipelines, delivery standards, and on-premise environment operations for Scala and Next.js applications.
Led CI/CD migrations and modernizations: Jenkins upgrades, repository migration from GitHub to Bitbucket, and consolidation of Bitbucket, GitHub, and Jenkins pipelines onto GitLab CI.
Migrated workloads from Apache Mesos to Kubernetes and implemented an infrastructure foundation with Terraform and Helm to deploy applications via GitOps using ArgoCD.
Standardized quality and branching processes by integrating SonarQube across repositories and migrating from GitHub Flow to GitFlow, including pipelines, documentation, and team training.
Built tooling to improve developer and QA experience, including a solution to locally test code running in the cluster and a Discord bot to answer common support questions.
Designed pipelines and tooling to automate Kong API Gateway routing configuration, enabling developers to manage routes with less operational dependency.
Built Java (Spring) backends for public-sector and payments clients (ANSES, Ministry of Production, AFIP, payment proxy) and Python services.
Developed ETLs with a custom Python tool; installed and configured Apache Druid and visualization dashboards (including Apache Superset).
Implemented Jenkins deployment pipelines and operated production EC2 instances running Docker Compose, monitoring host and application availability.
Delivered end-to-end features on the Swiss Medical platform (Java 1.6-1.8, Spring, JavaScript/Backbone, REST), including workflows with jBPM and Apache Camel.
Owned database migrations and related queries for those deliveries.
Contributed to the design and development of a middle manager component for the same platform.

proyectos.descripcion: DevOps remediation engine: FastAPI services/rules/consequences model, React/Vite admin UI, Dockerized delivery.
Reusable Terraform/Terragrunt modules: AWS (SNS to Teams alarms, Route53, IAM, Glue), ArgoCD, and kubeadm provisioning.
Self-managed Kubernetes (kubeadm/containerd/Flannel) via Terragrunt: bootstrap, declarative worker sync, and ArgoCD.
Ubuntu Server autoinstall USB (online/offline) with Docker/SSH/Git bootstrap for hands-off machine provisioning.
Cross-PC savegame sync: Go engine, web/desktop UI, Docker Compose, and SemVer releases via GitHub Actions.
YAML-driven SSH hop/tunnel orchestration, runnable with Docker/Python for internal network access.
